item: Claim trail source counts count outlets by domain, the key the same-source join uses, not by outlet labels (outlet list item 13, L4)
summary: A path's n_sources and sources, and the trail's n_sources, were the number of distinct outlet LABELS, while the same-source join that builds the paths keys on the outlet domain (else source_id). On the live path every feed of one domain already shares one outlet label, so what changes there is the other direction: two domains whose labels coincide, or articles of several deleted source rows (all shown as ?), counted as one source and now count as two. A direct caller passing feed labels without an outlet label (the tests) also no longer counts one outlet's feeds as several. The join and every count read one helper (_voice), the shown names stay one per counted voice, an article with neither key falls back to its name, and the same-source join detail names the outlet by the same rule as the path (input-order independent; none for a nameless voice). Eight tests: five fail on the old code, three guard the fallbacks and the nameless detail.
